__comment: TOSS (Tournament Organizer & Scoring System) — eFootball Arena — Complete Brand & Engineering Context for AI Generation

meta.description: Competitive eFootball tournament platform — create tournaments, submit match results with screenshot OCR verification, wager head-to-head battles with M-Pesa payouts.

project_type.target_audience: Kenyan eFootball gamers who want to compete in organized tournaments and wager real money on head-to-head matches.

frontend.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 (CSS variables + @theme block in index.css)

fonts.legacy: Rajdhani (referenced in tailwind config but NOT actually used in current CSS)

backend.database: sql.js (SQLite in-memory, persisted to file efootball.db)

builds.client: cd client && npm run build → dist/
builds.server: cd server && npm run build → dist/

design_system.theme: Dark gaming aesthetic — near-black backgrounds with neon orange accent

typography.display_font: Orbitron — used for hero numbers, scores, logo-style headings
typography.body_font: Inter — used for all body text, buttons, inputs, general UI
typography.mono_font: Geist Mono — referenced in constants.ts but minimal usage

layout.mobile_breakpoint: 1024px (lg:) — sidenav collapses to overlay with backdrop

design_system.css_approach: CSS custom properties (variables) + inline React styles via the S object in constants.ts. Tailwind is installed but utility classes are used sparingly — most styling is custom CSS with design tokens.

api_architecture.pattern: RESTful controllers → services → raw SQL (no ORM)

routes.auth: /api/auth — register, login, logout, me, profile CRUD, redeem-code, telegram-login, link/unlink telegram, forgot/reset password
routes.tournaments: /api/tournaments — CRUD, list (with filters), join, get participants/standings
routes.matches: /api/matches — list by tournament, single match, OCR upload, OCR submit, result submit, confirm, dispute, resolve (admin)
routes.images: /api/images — tournament-images list, upload banner, upload avatar
routes.admin: /api/admin — stats, users CRUD, tournaments CRUD, logs, admin codes CRUD (super admin only)
routes.wagers: /api/wagers — CRUD, accept, confirm, dispute, cancel, admin stats/resolve
routes.notifications: /api/notifications — list, mark read, mark all read
routes.deep_links: /t/:slugToken — redirect to tournament/app via shareable link

authentication.standard: POST /api/auth/login → JWT (7-day expiry, stored in localStorage as 'token')
authentication.telegram: POST /api/auth/telegram-login → validates initData with Telegram Bot API → auto-creates user if new → returns JWT
authentication.token_blacklist: On logout, token added to token_blacklist table with expiry

frontend_architecture.routing: React Router v6 BrowserRouter with Layout wrapper

global_state.AuthContext: user, login, logout, authLoading — token from localStorage
global_state.TelegramContext: WebApp init, user data from Telegram

pages.description: Landing hero, trending tournaments, platform stats, recent results, active tournaments
Tournament listing with search + filter chips (All/Open/Live/Ended), tournament cards
Tournament details with tabs (bracket/standings/players/overview), join button
Registration form with password strength meter — no sidenav layout
User profile card, stats, season progress, active tournaments, account menu
Admin panel — stats, users management, tournaments management, logs, codes (super admin)
Join tournament via access_token — phone input for M-Pesa payment, success state
Wager lobby — grid of open wagers with stake/pot display, accept modal with phone input
Wager match room — VS display, confirm winner buttons, dispute flow
List of my created + accepted wagers
Stub — global player rankings coming soon

shared_components.Layout: Sidenav (left, collapsible) + Topbar (hamburger, search, user dropdown) + main content area
shared_components.Icons: 30+ custom SVG icon components (Home, Trophy, Sword, Shield, Crown, Money, Lightning, etc.)
shared_components.OCRUpload: Screenshot upload with Tesseract.js score extraction (server-side)
shared_components.TelegramAutoLogin: Detects Telegram WebApp environment, auto-triggers auth

frontend_architecture.api_client: client/src/api/index.ts — fetch wrapper with JSON handling, typed methods per resource
frontend_architecture.styling_approach: Design tokens defined in constants.ts as the S object — imported and used as inline style props throughout components. CSS variables defined in index.css for global consistency. Minimal Tailwind utility class usage.
frontend_architecture.animations: Framer Motion for page transitions + custom keyframe animations (float-up, neon-pulse, skeleton-shimmer, spin-slow)

tournament_management.creation: Authenticated users with active subscription can create tournaments
tournament_management.joining: Public tournaments (free / paid entry via M-Pesa STK Push) or private (access_token)
tournament_management.bracket_generation: server/src/services/bracketService.ts — auto-generates matches based on participant count

match_result_submission.flow: players submit scores → opponent confirms → admin resolves disputes
match_result_submission.ocr_verification: Screenshot upload → Tesseract.js extracts scores → auto-submit if confidence >= 90%, manual review if 55-89%, reject if < 55%
match_result_submission.fraud_detection: screenshot hash comparison, OCR cross-validation, team name matching in result_submissions and fraud_logs

wager_system.flow: Creator sets stake + phone → Paynecta STK Push → Challenger accepts + pays → Both confirm winner → Payout to winner minus 10% commission
wager_system.states: awaiting_payment → active → pending_confirm → completed | disputed | expired | cancelled

verification_system.checks: OCR team name match, score extraction, confidence scoring, screenshot hash deduplication

admin_subscription_system.limits: Tournament creation capped by tier, sub-admin assignment for Scale+
admin_subscription_system.payment: M-Pesa STK Push via subscription flow

brand_personality.voice: Direct but premium — like a high-end sports betting app mixed with a fighting game UI
brand_personality.design_philosophy: Dark, focused, every element earns its place. No decoration for decoration's sake. Orange accent used sparingly for CTAs and status highlights only.

client/src/.index.css: Tailwind import + @theme block + CSS variables + base styles + custom animations
client/src/.constants.ts: Design tokens (COLORS, FONT, RADIUS, SPACE, S object) — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH
client/src/.components/layout/Layout.tsx: App shell — Sidenav + Topbar + content wrapper
client/src/.pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin CRUD panel (uses direct fetch, not api client)

server/src/.index.ts: Express app — middleware, rate limits, route mounts, Socket.IO init, error handler
server/src/.db.ts: sql.js database init — table creation, migration ALTERs, auto-save, db export wrapper
server/src/.types.ts: All TypeScript interfaces (User, Tournament, Match, Wager, etc.)
server/src/.api/tgApi.ts: Telegram Bot API client for initData validation
server/src/.controllers/authController.ts: Login, redeem, forgot/reset password, telegram auth
server/src/.controllers/adminController.ts: Stats, user CRUD, tournament management, logs
server/src/.controllers/matchController.ts: Match CRUD, OCR, result submit, confirm/dispute/resolve
server/src/.controllers/tournamentController.ts: Tournament CRUD, join, participants, standings generation
M-Pesa payment for tournament entry fees
server/src/.controllers/verificationController.ts: Screenshot verification, fraud detection, admin review
server/src/.controllers/wagerController.ts: Wager CRUD, accept, confirm, dispute, resolve
server/src/.services/mpesaService.ts: DEAD CODE — old M-Pesa service, not imported anywhere
server/src/.services/ocrService.ts: Tesseract.js OCR processing for match screenshots
server/src/.services/paynectaService.ts: Paynecta API client (STK Push, queryStatus, getLinks, getBanks, getCurrencyRates)

brand_generation_prompts.logo_direction: Minimal geometric mark — gaming/esports aesthetic, works on dark backgrounds, orange + black, should feel competitive and premium. Avoid football/soccer clichés. Think esports team logo meets fintech precision.
brand_generation_prompts.page_design_direction: Dark (#0A0A0A) backgrounds, subtle borders at 8% white opacity, cards at #141414. Orange (#F97316) as primary accent for CTAs and active states only. Headings in Orbitron (display), body in Inter. Generous whitespace — never cramped. Animations are subtle: float-up on mount, gentle neon pulse on active elements.

component_rules.buttons: Primary buttons use accent color (#F97316) with dark text, full-width, 12px border-radius. Secondary buttons are ghost-style with muted text. Hover state: slight opacity change only — never color shifts.
component_rules.cards: Single border (rgba white 0.08), 20px border-radius, no shadows except subtle bottom shadow (0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)).
component_rules.inputs: Dark surface (#141414), 12px border-radius, 1px border at rgba(255,255,255,0.08), white text, no focus ring — border changes to orange on focus.
component_rules.badges: 8px border-radius, small (10px font), colored pill — open=green, live=blue, ended=gray, disputed=amber.
component_rules.typography_hierarchy: H1: 20px/800/white, H2: 16px/700/white, H3: 14px/700/white, Body: 14px/normal/#A1A1A1, Caption: 12px/normal/#737373, Micro: 10px/normal/#525252

anti_patterns_to_avoid: Rounded corners smaller than 8px or larger than 20px
Using more than one accent color (orange is it)
Light theme versions — this is dark-only
brand_generation_prompts.copy_voice: Short, direct, competitive. Imperative mood for CTAs: 'Join Tournament', 'Submit Result', 'Claim Winnings'. Never use exclamation marks in UI copy. Status labels are terse: 'Open', 'Live', 'Ended', 'Disputed'.

engineering_conventions.code_style: Minimal comments, functional components, early returns, no unnecessary abstractions
engineering_conventions.file_naming: PascalCase for components, camelCase for utilities/controllers/services, Routes files = XxxRoutes.ts
engineering_conventions.imports: Relative imports within same module (./), absolute via import.meta.dirname for server
engineering_conventions.state_recovery: Always check — use try/catch around sql.js operations, optional chaining everywhere, graceful fallbacks for missing env vars
engineering_conventions.error_handling: Controller-level try/catch → 400/500 JSON responses. No uncaught exceptions. Frontend shows error.message directly.
engineering_conventions.no_dependencies_principle: Prefer writing utilities over adding npm packages. Current dependency count is intentionally low.

working_features: Match result submission with opponent confirmation
Wager challenges (full backend, basic frontend pages)
Paynecta M-Pesa integration (STK Push for wagers + subscriptions)
known_gaps: AdminDashboard uses direct fetch instead of api client layer
Leaderboard page is a placeholder (API endpoint exists)
Tournament edit has no frontend form (backend supports it)
Match dispute resolution has no admin UI panel
Standings tab exists in TournamentDetailPage but never fetches data
Forgot password / reset password pages not built
Rate limiting is lenient (100 req/15min global, 10 req/15min auth)
current_status.technical_debt: Low-to-mbase is clean and well-structured. Main issues are incomplete features rather than messy code.
